# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated from the command registry (crates/engine/src/help.rs); do not edit by hand.
     Rewrite it with: UPDATE_USER_DOCS=1 cargo test -p pdfcraft-engine --lib help:: -->

On macOS PdfCraft uses ⌘ (Command); on Windows, Linux and FreeBSD the same shortcuts use Ctrl. ⇧ is Shift and ⌃ is Control. The web app shows the macOS keys; press Ctrl instead of ⌘ on Windows and Linux.

The same list is in the app: **Menu → Help → Keyboard shortcuts** (⌘/), where you can search it. Press ⌘K to find any command by name, with or without a shortcut.

## File

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| Open | ⌘O | Ctrl+O |
| Save | ⌘S | Ctrl+S |
| Save as | ⇧⌘S | Ctrl+Shift+S |
| Close file | ⌘W | Ctrl+W |
| Close all | ⇧⌘W | Ctrl+Shift+W |
| Print | ⌘P | Ctrl+P |
| Document properties | ⌘D | Ctrl+D |

## Edit

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| Undo | ⌘Z | Ctrl+Z |
| Redo | ⇧⌘Z | Ctrl+Shift+Z |
| Find | ⌘F | Ctrl+F |
| Advanced search | ⇧⌘F | Ctrl+Shift+F |
| Preferences | ⌘, | Ctrl+, |

## View

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| Find tools and commands | ⌘K | Ctrl+K |
| Fit visible | ⌘3 | Ctrl+3 |
| Full screen mode | ⌘L | Ctrl+L |
| Read mode | ⌃⌘H | Ctrl+H |
| Go to page | ⇧⌘N | Ctrl+Shift+N |

## Pages

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| New bookmark | ⌘B | Ctrl+B |

## Help

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| Keyboard shortcuts | ⌘/ | Ctrl+/ |

## Tools

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| JavaScript console | ⌘J | Ctrl+J |
| JavaScript debugger | ⇧⌘J | Ctrl+Shift+J |

## Document view

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| Next / previous match | ⌘G / ⇧⌘G | Ctrl+G / Ctrl+Shift+G |
| Copy selected text | ⌘C | Ctrl+C |
| Select a word | Double-click | Double-click |
| Clear selection / close find | Esc | Esc |
| Actual size | ⌘1 | Ctrl+1 |
| Zoom to page level | ⌘0 | Ctrl+0 |
| Fit to width | ⌘2 | Ctrl+2 |
| Zoom in / out (also pinch or ⌘-scroll) | ⌘+ / ⌘− | Ctrl++ / Ctrl+− |
| Rotate view | ⇧⌘+ / ⇧⌘− | Ctrl+Shift++ / Ctrl+Shift+− |
| Previous view | ⌘[ | Ctrl+[ |
| Next view | ⌘] | Ctrl+] |
| First / last page | Home / End | Home / End |
| Previous / next page | ← / →, ⌘Page Up / ⌘Page Down | ← / →, Ctrl+Page Up / Ctrl+Page Down |
| Select (V) | V | V |
| Hand (H) | H / Space (hold) | H / Space (hold) |

## Organize pages

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| Delete selected pages (Organize) | Delete | Delete |
| Select all pages (Organize) | ⌘A | Ctrl+A |

## Editing objects

With **Edit objects**, a selected object takes these keys:

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| Move by 1 point (10 with Shift) | ← → ↑ ↓ | ← → ↑ ↓ |
| Bring forward / to front | ⌘] / ⇧⌘] | Ctrl+] / Ctrl+Shift+] |
| Send backward / to back | ⌘[ / ⇧⌘[ | Ctrl+[ / Ctrl+Shift+[ |
| Delete | Delete | Delete |
| Deselect | Esc | Esc |

## Forms

| Action | macOS | Windows, Linux and FreeBSD |
|---|---|---|
| Next / previous field | Tab / ⇧Tab | Tab / Shift+Tab |
| Finish typing in a field | Return | Enter |
| Cancel typing in a field | Esc | Esc |
